verdict.rationale: A data-use or AI-training policy is a fair privacy question for remote desktop software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI training, data-use policy, or an opt-out. Self-hosting and end-to-end encryption are adjacent privacy controls and do not show a documented guarantee or setting that keeps user data out of AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
